subject: literacy
concept: Tracing the evolution of the English language and literary form across historical periods
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares short excerpts of English from different historical periods and notices linguistic changes
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences excerpts by approximate era based on language style and form
exercise.abstract: Student explains a specific way English language or literary form changed across a described historical span

misconception_flags: assumes English literary language has remained essentially unchanged across centuries

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
